text: {"schema_version":"weekly-upgrade-v1","week_id":"2026-W38","snapshot_sha256":"46f8dbb0dd5fbf51afe35bf4e3ba6f3d4cd3ebdad917d91e52a2e3755c0327f5","proposal_id":"wu-46f8dbb0","verdict":"revise","violated_rules":["weak-controls: n=4 fixtures × 1 seed is insufficient statistical power for the paired accuracy and 10% median wall-time claims","incomplete-measurement-path: change_surface lists only a config JSON; the evaluator/runner, decision parser, and fixture label mapping are not identified in the proposal","confounded-timing: no warm-up, arm ordering, prefix-cache reset, or paired-difference protocol specified for wall time","threshold-from-thin-air: the 10% median wall-time reduction target is asserted without pre-registered variance or CI"],"objections":[{"claim":"With four fixtures balanced 2/2 and a single seed, a single decision flip shifts critic_decision_accuracy by 25 percentage points, so the pass rule 'candidate ≥ baseline' cannot distinguish a real regression from sampling noise.","repo_references":[{"path":"bench/weekly_upgrade_eval/fixtures.json","locator":"critic_fatal_circular, critic_fatal_dominance, critic_proceed_fixable, critic_proceed_theorem (4 balanced items)","sha256":"b6c78b403fae9288497b480778479a7578c3588923daa73309c1ef7dd2d5ce13"}],"falsifier":"Increase seeds to at least 3 (e.g., [0,1,2]) and/or expand fixture_ids to the full balanced critic subset available in the manifest, and specify paired-arm agreement/non-inferiority rather than raw accuracy comparison."},{"claim":"Median wall time computed from four paired measurements per arm is not robust; no confidence interval, paired-difference test, or minimum detectable effect is pre-registered, so a 10% median reduction can be produced or destroyed by a single outlier or by warm-up/prefix-cache order effects.","repo_references":[{"path":"agent_wrapper/generation_policy.py","locator":"critic_current xhigh vs critic_medium medium — differ only in Qwen reasoning_effort","sha256":"3a45aa1303bb0f53fe73533b9750b07049acf3c0a0eaa4107582812f5db449a5"}],"falsifier":"Pre-register a paired per-fixture wall-time delta metric (e.g., median of per-fixture candidate/baseline ratios) with an explicit warm-up call per arm, fixed arm interleaving, and prefix-cache handling; require the 10% threshold against that paired statistic, not raw arm medians."},{"claim":"The change_surface names only experiments/qwen_critic_effort_ab.json, which does not exist in the snapshot and does not identify the evaluator that maps model outputs to decisions or scores them against fixture labels; the executor cannot reproduce 'critic_decision_accuracy' without that path pinned.","repo_references":[{"path":"bench/weekly_upgrade_eval/manifest.py","locator":"bench/weekly_upgrade_eval — plausible evaluator location, but not referenced by the proposal","sha256":"31328e0480c1d460a03ef5b1ffd74e3617ee1c7c3c6638eb35f1ce50b6501364"}],"falsifier":"Include the runner/scorer path and its content sha in change_surface or repo_references, and specify the exact decision-parsing rule and label field used for scoring so a separate evaluator can execute without inference."},{"claim":"Coupling 'malformed or missing decisions count as incorrect' to the primary metric conflates parser robustness with reasoning-effort effect; xhigh Qwen thinking traces can exceed max tokens more often, biasing accuracy against baseline for a reason unrelated to critic quality.","repo_references":[{"path":"agent_wrapper/generation_policy.py","locator":"Qwen thinking + reasoning_effort=xhigh path (preserve_tool_reasoning) is materially longer than medium","sha256":"3a45aa1303bb0f53fe73533b9750b07049acf3c0a0eaa4107582812f5db449a5"}],"falsifier":"Report a separate 'decision_parseable_rate' alongside accuracy, and either exclude unparseable rows from accuracy or fix max_tokens/context so both arms terminate cleanly; pre-declare which policy applies before running."},{"claim":"No pinned decoding-determinism controls are specified; with only seed=0 and no assertion of deterministic sampling on the vLLM path, single-run measurements per fixture are not reproducible and cannot be verified by a separate evaluator.","repo_references":[{"path":"cron/serve-models.sh","locator":"vllm-qwen served with prefix caching / speculative decoding — nondeterministic under batching","sha256":"d8c2d15f9b1365b0d73b71c7c9f8e6df772d78876f6e913e57417d7ce270f663"}],"falsifier":"Either add multiple seeds and require agreement across seeds, or document and enforce a deterministic-decoding server configuration for this experiment (e.g., disable speculative decoding / batch=1) and record the resulting server hash in the run manifest."}],"cheapest_decisive_test":"Re-run the same two profiles across ≥3 seeds and the full balanced critic subset available in bench/weekly_upgrade_eval/fixtures.json, computing a paired per-fixture wall-time ratio (median across pairs) and a paired accuracy-difference statistic; pass only if candidate is non-inferior on accuracy at a pre-registered margin AND the paired median wall-time ratio is ≤0.90 with an explicit warm-up call per arm.","residual_risks":["Even after re-scoping, xhigh vs medium wall-time deltas may be dominated by prefix-cache and server-side batching effects unrelated to reasoning_effort.","Fixture labels in bench/weekly_upgrade_eval/fixtures.json may already reflect a single grader's decisions; if that grader is Qwen-authored, evaluating a Qwen effort change risks a mild circular-grading bias not addressed by the current pass rule.","A medium-effort critic that meets the wall-time bar in EVALUATION_ONLY could still drift on out-of-distribution critic prompts encountered in the live loop; the four-fixture subset does not generalize.","Vendor snapshot notes report 91/349 codex failures and 5/224 claude failures in the telemetry window — infrastructure noise in the environment could bleed into timing measurements if arms are not tightly interleaved."],"external_claims":[]}
